messages:
deploy-bot: STARTING multi-service fanout deploy
env=prod services=[runtime, api, console] commit=7f21b9a tag=v2.4.1 change_window=2200-2300Z
status: runtime: queued, api: queued, console: queued

sofia-ng: ack — watching dashboards and synthetic checks :eyes:

deploy-bot: runtime -> IN PROGRESS on gpu-pool-3 (task=4821)

jake-k: noted. pinning strategy: if api canary fails we pin api to v2.4.0 and stop console rollout.

deploy-bot: runtime -> SUCCESS (duration=45s, median_latency=38ms) :tada:

deploy-bot: api -> IN PROGRESS (rolling canaries: canary-1, canary-2)

maria-p: canary-1 logs show repeated upstream 502s starting at +12s after request. pasted: ```HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
Content-Length: 175```

jake-k: that's the pattern we saw in staging earlier. canary-1 hitting mismatch with new connection pool settings. recommend pause and rollback canary-1.

release-oncall: PAUSING rollout for api. initiating rollback on canary-1 to tag v2.4.0. console rollout: HOLD until api is green. Creating a short incident ticket in #incidents if more than 2 canaries fail.

deploy-bot: api -> PARTIAL_FAIL on canary-1. rollback started (rollback_target=tag:v2.4.0, action=deploy-revert). canary-2 still pending.

sofia-ng: confirming observability alert fired (api.canary.502) and synthetic failed for east-us. I've muted noisy alerts and escalated to infra-conn.

deploy-bot: console -> SKIPPED (dependency: api not healthy). console status: held.

deploy-bot: api rollback -> SUCCESS on canary-1 (reverted to tag v2.4.0). canary-1 health checks passing again.

jake-k: once canary-1 is stable for 5 minutes, we can either re-run canary with a patched image or pin prod to v2.4.0 and open a follow-up to investigate connection pool diff.

release-oncall: we will pin api to v2.4.0 for the rest of the change window. release notes updated with rollback and reason: "upstream 502 due to connection pool mismatch on canary". follow-up: incident alpha-2026-03-20 created.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY COMPLETE (partial). summary: runtime=success, api=rolled-back-to-v2.4.0 on affected canaries, console=not-deployed (held). artifacts: tag=v2.4.1 pushed but not promoted for api. logs: https://logs.internal/release/1769001234

sofia-ng: thanks all. I'll keep monitoring and will post if we resume. :thumbsup:
